title: Understanding Logistic Regression
text: Logistic regression is a linear classifier. It tries to find a linear boundary between classes. Consider the shape of the data distribution and think about whether a straight line can separate the classes.

title: Analyzing the Data Distribution
text: Look at the distribution of the orange and blue points. Does the pattern suggest a linear separation?

title: Boundary B and Logistic Regression
text: If logistic regression creates a linear boundary, think about what kind of boundary would be needed to separate the classes in this dataset. Is it linear or non-linear?
